similarities.claim: Defines structured tool metadata and schemas that clients can validate before invocation.

differences.claim: MCP is a protocol surface, not a project-local governance system.

lessons_for_afol.lesson: Keep agent-facing command outputs schema-shaped so callers can validate compact structured results.

do_not_copy.reason: Do not treat protocol flexibility as product governance; AFOL still needs local policy and lifecycle rules.
